entries.name: DAAD Research Grants – Doctoral Programmes in Germany (CLMTV / Cambodia)
entries.provider: DAAD – German Academic Exchange Service (funded by the German Federal Foreign Office)
entries.fields: Any academic discipline
covers: monthly stipend of EUR 1,400 for doctoral candidates
health, accident and personal liability insurance
rent subsidy and family allowances where applicable
entries.eligibility: Excellent master's degree (normally not older than six years) and a research proposal agreed with a supervising professor at a German university or research institute; for full doctoral programmes funding of up to 4 years; short-term research grants (2–12 months) for candidates doing a doctorate at home; language proficiency required by the host
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants are covered by the DAAD Regional Office Hanoi (CLMTV: Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam); applications go through the DAAD portal with the CLMTV deadlines — Doctoral Programmes in Germany and bi-nationally supervised doctorates 21 October 2026, short-term Research Grants 7 October 2026 (for funding starting 2027).
entries.deadline_note: Annual call; for Cambodia the deadline is in October (21 October 2026 for doctoral programmes starting 2027; 7 October 2026 for short-term research grants)
entries.language_req: English or German proficiency as required by the host institution

entries.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
entries.provider: European Union – Erasmus+ programme (European Education and Culture Executive Agency)
entries.fields: Any field – each of the 200+ joint master programmes covers its own discipline; study takes place in at least two European countries
covers: participation costs including tuition, library/lab fees and full insurance
monthly living allowance of EUR 1,400 for up to 24 months
contribution to travel and installation costs
entries.eligibility: Bachelor degree (or equivalent) meeting the consortium's admission criteria; open to students of any nationality worldwide; a student may receive only one Erasmus Mundus scholarship; each consortium sets its own academic and language requirements
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian nationals apply directly to the joint master consortium of their choice via the programme's own website; no embassy or ministry nomination is involved. Non-EU applicants are ranked in the worldwide scholarship competition.
entries.deadline_note: Each programme sets its own deadline; most applications for September 2027 entry must be submitted between October 2026 and January/February 2027
entries.language_req: English (typically IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or the programme's teaching language

entries.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (ESKAS) – Research Fellowship and PhD
entries.provider: Swiss Confederation – Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS/ESKAS), State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
entries.fields: Any discipline (research at doctoral level at a Swiss public university, ETH or research institute)
covers: tuition fee waiver at most host universities
return airfare at the end of the scholarship for nationals of eligible countries
entries.eligibility: Master's degree (or equivalent) obtained before the scholarship start; born after 31 December 1991 (under 35); letter of support from an academic supervisor at a Swiss university is mandatory; applicants must not have stayed in Switzerland for more than one year at the start; postdoctoral scholarships are no longer awarded from 2027/28
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is on the ESKAS country list for the Research Fellowship and PhD scholarship types; Cambodian candidates apply through the ESKAS online portal and the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangkok (bangkok@eda.admin.ch), which handles Cambodia. The 2027-2028 call for Cambodia opened 1 September 2026 and closes 24 November 2026.
entries.deadline_note: Opens 1 September and closes late November each year (2027-2028 cycle for Cambodia: 1 September – 24 November 2026)
entries.language_req: Sufficient English (or French/German/Italian) as required by the Swiss supervisor; no fixed test score

entries.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
entries.provider: Government of Hungary – Tempus Public Foundation
entries.fields: Any field for Cambodian applicants, primarily agriculture, engineering, economics, natural sciences, social sciences, computer science and IT (bachelor, master, one-tier master, PhD and preparatory programmes)
covers: monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 (bachelor/master) or HUF 140,000–180,000 (PhD)
free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 monthly housing contribution
Hungarian public health insurance plus supplementary medical insurance
entries.eligibility: Cambodian citizen aged 18 or over by 31 August of the intake year; secondary school certificate (bachelor), bachelor degree (master) or master degree (PhD); must meet the host university's programme and language requirements; nominated by Cambodia's sending partner ministry
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is a Stipendium Hungaricum partner country with roughly 30 places per year. Apply online at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu and submit the required documents to the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS), which nominates candidates to Tempus Public Foundation.
entries.deadline_note: Opens in mid-November and closes 15 January (14:00 CET) each year; the 2027/2028 call opens in November 2026 with a deadline expected around 15 January 2027
entries.language_req: English (typically B2 / IELTS 5.5–6.5 depending on university) or Hungarian for Hungarian-taught programmes

entries.name: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları)
entries.provider: Government of the Republic of Türkiye – Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
entries.fields: Any field at Turkish state universities (associate, undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes)
covers: monthly stipend of TL 4,500 (associate/bachelor), TL 6,500 (master) or TL 9,000 (PhD)
entries.eligibility: Not a Turkish citizen; under 21 for undergraduate, under 30 for master's and under 35 for PhD applicants; minimum academic average of 70% (undergraduate), 75% (graduate) or 90% (health sciences); graduates of or current students at Turkish universities are not eligible
entries.cambodia_note: Open to applicants from all countries including Cambodia; apply online through the Türkiye Bursları application system; interviews may be arranged through the Turkish Embassy in Phnom Penh.
entries.deadline_note: Opens around 10 January and closes around 20 February each year (2026 cycle: 10 January – 20 February 2026); the 2027 cycle is expected in January–February 2027
entries.language_req: No test required at application; programmes are taught in Turkish (one-year preparatory course provided) or English

entries.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Programme
entries.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs – managed by Campus France
entries.fields: Science and technology (biology and health, ecological transition, mathematics and digital, engineering sciences) and humanities and social sciences (French and European history and civilisation, law and political science, economics and management)
covers: monthly allowance of EUR 1,200 (master) or EUR 2,100 (PhD)
entries.eligibility: Non-French nationality; age limits set in each call (recent calls: no older than 27 for master's and 32 for PhD); candidates are nominated by the French higher education institution that admits them – students cannot apply directly; currently enrolled or admitted to a master's or doctoral programme in France
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodians are eligible but must be proposed by a French university or grande école; Campus France Cambodge at the Institut français du Cambodge in Phnom Penh advises candidates on securing a nomination.
entries.deadline_note: Call opens 1 October each year; institutions must submit nominations to Campus France by early January (the 2026 call closed 8 January 2026) with results at the end of March; the 2027 call is expected October 2026 – January 2027
entries.language_req: French or English depending on the programme; no fixed test score in the scholarship rules

entries.name: Bourses France Excellence – Embassy of France in Cambodia (formerly BGF)
entries.provider: Embassy of France in Cambodia (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs), co-financed with Cambodian partner institutions
entries.fields: Any field (2026-2027 campaign: co-funded doctorates; earlier campaigns also funded master's degrees)
covers: international travel (co-financed with the partner institution)
entries.eligibility: Cambodian nationality; letter of acceptance or pre-acceptance from a French institution; agreement in principle from a thesis supervisor in a French laboratory; mandatory co-financing agreement with a partner institution such as the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) or the Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology (CADT)
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia-specific programme run by the French Embassy in Phnom Penh with Campus France Cambodge; the 2026-2027 doctoral campaign ran 16 March – 27 April 2026 (22:00). Results are published on the embassy website.
entries.deadline_note: Opens in mid-March and closes in late April each year; the next campaign is expected March–April 2027
entries.language_req: French or English depending on the host laboratory

entries.name: ARES Scholarships for International Training (Bourses de formations internationales)
entries.provider: ARES – Académie de recherche et d'enseignement supérieur (Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles, Belgian development cooperation)
entries.fields: Development-related specialised master's degrees and short advanced training courses at French-speaking Belgian universities (public health, environment, water, agronomy, economics, IT, transport, etc.)
entries.eligibility: National of and resident in one of ARES's partner countries (Cambodia included); relevant degree; at least 2 years of relevant professional experience for specialised masters; age limits (under 40 for masters, under 45 for short courses at the start of training); proficiency in French (most programmes) or English
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is one of the roughly 29–31 ARES partner countries; Cambodian candidates apply directly online through the ARES application form for the 2027-2028 call – no embassy step.
entries.deadline_note: Call published in August with a deadline in September each year (the 2027-2028 call document was published August 2026; aggregators list 18 September 2026 as the deadline – verify on the ARES page)
entries.language_req: French (most programmes) or English (selected programmes)

entries.name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships
entries.provider: VLIR-UOS – Flemish Interuniversity Council, University Development Cooperation (funded by the Belgian government)
entries.fields: Development-relevant English-taught master programmes at Flemish universities (water resources, epidemiology, food technology, sustainable development, governance, etc.)
entries.eligibility: National of and resident in one of the VLIR-UOS scholarship countries (Cambodia included); no older than 35 (initial master) or 45 (advanced master) on 1 January of the intake year; preference for candidates employed in higher education, government or civil society; must meet the programme's admission requirements
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is one of the 29 VLIR-UOS scholarship countries; Cambodian applicants apply to the ICP Connect master programme directly and request the scholarship in the same application.
entries.deadline_note: The 2027-2028 call is expected to open in mid-November 2026; programme deadlines usually fall between February and March 2027
entries.language_req: English (typically IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80–90 as set by the programme)

entries.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
entries.provider: Government of Ireland – Higher Education Authority (HEA)
entries.fields: Any field at NFQ level 9 (taught/research master's, postgraduate diploma) or level 10 (PhD) at eligible Irish higher education institutions
covers: EUR 10,000 stipend for one year of full-time study
full waiver of tuition fees and registration charge for the scholarship year
entries.eligibility: Domiciled outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK; conditional or final offer of admission to an eligible Irish institution at the time of application; two references uploaded via the online portal; 60 awards per year
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodians apply directly to the HEA online portal once they hold an offer from an Irish institution; no embassy involvement.
entries.deadline_note: Opens in late January and closes in March each year (2026 call closed 12 March 2026 at 17:00 Irish time); the 2027 call is expected January–March 2027
entries.language_req: Must meet the host institution's English requirement (typically IELTS 6.5)

entries.name: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students (MAECI)
entries.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
entries.fields: Any field: master's degrees (laurea magistrale), AFAM arts/music/dance programmes, PhD, research projects under academic supervision, and Italian language and culture courses
covers: monthly grant of EUR 900 (EUR 10,800 for a 12-month scholarship; EUR 3,600 for language courses)
tuition fee exemption at the host institution (per institution rules)
entries.eligibility: Citizen of an eligible country (Cambodia is on the 2026-2027 list); age under 28 for master's/AFAM/language courses, under 30 for PhD and under 40 for research; academic qualification for the chosen course; Italian language B2 or, for English-taught courses, English B2
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia appears on MAECI's list of eligible countries; Cambodians apply online through the Study in Italy portal (studyinitaly.esteri.it), with the Embassy of Italy in Phnom Penh as reference point.
entries.deadline_note: Call published around February/March with a deadline in late March or April each year (2026-2027 call closed 26 March 2026 at 14:00 CET); the 2027-2028 call is expected February–March 2027
entries.language_req: Italian B2, or English B2 for English-taught programmes

entries.name: Czech Government Scholarships for Developing Countries
entries.provider: Government of the Czech Republic – Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (Foreign Development Cooperation)
entries.fields: Selected follow-up master's and doctoral programmes in technical fields, agriculture, economics and natural sciences at Czech public universities
covers: monthly stipend of CZK 16,000 (master) or CZK 24,960 (PhD)
accommodation and meals at subsidised student rates
health care under Czech public insurance
Czech language preparatory course for Czech-taught programmes
entries.eligibility: Cambodian citizen not permanently resident in the Czech Republic; bachelor degree for master's programmes or master's degree for doctoral programmes; good English (or Czech after preparatory year); travel costs are not covered
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is one of the 13 eligible countries. Apply through the MEYS online portal; the Embassy of the Czech Republic in Phnom Penh announces the call each year and coordinates with Cambodian applicants. The 2027/2028 round runs 21 August – 30 September 2026.
entries.deadline_note: Opens in late July/August and closes 30 September each year (2027/2028: 21 August – 30 September 2026)
entries.language_req: English (programmes in English) or Czech after a preparatory language year

entries.name: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic (NSP)
entries.provider: Government of the Slovak Republic – Ministry of Education, administered by SAIA
entries.fields: Any field – study stays for master's students (1–2 semesters), research stays for PhD students, and teaching/research stays for university teachers, researchers and artists (1–10 months)
covers: monthly scholarship of EUR 620 (master's students) or EUR 1,025.50 and up (PhD students, researchers, teachers, depending on experience)
travel allowance for international students and PhD students based on distance
entries.eligibility: Open to applicants from any country; master's students must be enrolled abroad and come for a 1–2 semester stay (not a full degree); PhD students and researchers need an acceptance/invitation letter from a Slovak host university or research institute; no age limit
entries.cambodia_note: No country restrictions, so Cambodian nationals apply directly online at scholarships.sk; no embassy nomination.
entries.deadline_note: Two rounds each year: 31 October (16:00 CET) for stays in the summer semester, and 30 April for stays in the winter semester of the next academic year
entries.language_req: Language of the host institution (English or Slovak); no fixed test score

entries.name: Romanian Government Scholarships for Foreign Citizens (MFA)
entries.provider: Government of Romania – Ministry of Foreign Affairs
entries.fields: Any field except medicine, dentistry and pharmacy
covers: monthly stipend (approximately EUR 65 bachelor, EUR 75 master, EUR 85 PhD equivalent in RON)
entries.eligibility: Citizen of a non-EU country (Cambodia eligible); average grade of at least 7/10 (or 'good') in previous studies; age under 35 for bachelor's and under 45 for master's/PhD; bachelor's and master's programmes are taught in Romanian (after a preparatory year); PhD may be in English or another foreign language; international travel and other costs not covered
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodians apply directly online through the StudyInRomania platform ('Apply for MFA scholarships'); the Embassy of Romania accredited to Cambodia (in Bangkok) can be consulted.
entries.deadline_note: Opens mid-February and closes 31 March each year (2026-2027 window: 16 February – 31 March 2026, results around 15 July); the 2027-2028 call is expected February–March 2027
entries.language_req: Romanian (preparatory year provided) for bachelor's/master's; English possible at PhD level

entries.name: Open Doors: Russian Scholarship Project (International Olympiad)
entries.provider: Government of the Russian Federation – Ministry of Science and Higher Education, run by the Association of Global Universities
entries.fields: 14+ subject areas including engineering, computer science, physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, economics, medicine, education, linguistics, political science and more
covers: tuition-free study under the Russian Government education quota
monthly state stipend as a quota student
entries.eligibility: Foreign citizens or stateless persons with the previous level of education completed (or completing it in the year of the olympiad): secondary education (bachelor track), bachelor (master track), master/specialist (doctoral track), PhD (postdoctoral track); no age limit; selection via online portfolio, testing and, for the doctoral track, interview; international travel and insurance not covered
entries.cambodia_note: Open to all foreign citizens including Cambodians; register directly on the Open Doors website – winners receive a quota place without going through the embassy competition. Registration for the 2026/27 olympiad runs 20 August – 1 November 2026.
entries.deadline_note: Registration opens 20 August and closes around 1 November each year (portfolio stage until mid-November), with further stages in November–February
entries.language_req: English or Russian (working languages of the olympiad; programme language depends on university)

entries.name: Russian Government Quota Scholarship (Rossotrudnichestvo)
entries.provider: Government of the Russian Federation – Ministry of Science and Higher Education / Rossotrudnichestvo
entries.fields: Wide range including engineering, IT, nuclear and civil engineering, medicine, economics, law, international relations, arts, culture and tourism
covers: tuition-free study at a Russian state university
preparatory Russian language year where needed
entries.eligibility: Cambodian citizen with the required prior qualification (secondary certificate, bachelor or master); selection through the national competition organised with Cambodia's Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport and the Russian House in Phnom Penh; international travel and medical insurance are at the student's expense
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia receives an annual quota (MoEYS announced 40 places for 2025-2026 for students and civil servants). Candidates register on education-in-russia.com and are selected via MoEYS and the Russian Centre for Science and Culture (Russian House), Preah Norodom Blvd, Phnom Penh (tel. 023 213 508).
entries.deadline_note: Registration on education-in-russia.com usually opens in the autumn with country selection deadlines between December and March; check MoEYS and Russian House Phnom Penh announcements for the 2027/28 dates
entries.language_req: Russian (preparatory year available) or English for selected programmes

entries.name: Canada-ASEAN Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2)
entries.provider: Global Affairs Canada
entries.fields: Study or research linked to the UN Sustainable Development Goals (poverty reduction, climate action, gender equality, etc.), 4–8 month exchanges
covers: tuition-waived exchange at the Canadian host institution (value roughly CAD 10,200–15,900 depending on level and duration)
entries.eligibility: Citizen of an ASEAN member state including Cambodia; enrolled full-time at a home institution that has an exchange agreement with a Canadian college or university; short-term study/research of 4–8 months; not holding Canadian citizenship/permanent residence or a pending application
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students cannot apply directly: the Canadian partner institution submits the application on their behalf, so candidates must go through their home university's international office and its Canadian partner.
entries.deadline_note: Canadian institutions submit applications around March each year for exchanges starting from August; the 2027-2028 call is expected in early 2027
entries.language_req: English or French as required by the Canadian host institution

entries.name: MASHAV Professional Training Courses in Israel
entries.provider: MASHAV – Israel's Agency for International Development Cooperation, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
entries.fields: Short professional courses (2–4 weeks) in agriculture, water management, education, public health, entrepreneurship and innovation, community development, gender equality and more
entries.eligibility: Professionals from developing countries with a relevant academic degree or professional background and current employment in the course field; good command of English; typically aged 25–50; international airfare is paid by the participant or a sponsor
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodians apply for individual courses through the MASHAV online form and are screened by the Embassy of Israel in Phnom Penh; Cambodia and Israel signed an education cooperation MoU in February 2026.
entries.deadline_note: Course-by-course deadlines year-round, usually 6–8 weeks before each course starts (e.g., 1 June 2026 for some mid-2026 courses)
entries.language_req: English

entries.name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
entries.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with participating Dutch universities
entries.fields: Any field offered by the participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences
covers: one-off EUR 5,000 paid in the first year of study
entries.eligibility: Nationality outside the European Economic Area (Cambodia qualifies); applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch institution; must meet the institution's admission requirements; not previously enrolled in a Dutch degree programme
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodians apply through the participating institution's own NL Scholarship procedure after applying for admission; no embassy step.
entries.deadline_note: Institution deadlines usually fall between 1 February and 1 May for the September intake
entries.language_req: Institution's English requirement (typically IELTS 6.0–6.5)

entries.name: Harpswell Foundation Leadership Residences for young women
entries.provider: Harpswell Foundation (US nonprofit)
entries.fields: any; residents study at universities in Phnom Penh
covers: free housing in a Harpswell dormitory in Phnom Penh
housing in Harpswell dormitory in Phnom Penh
entries.eligibility: Cambodian young women, mainly from rural provinces, who have been admitted to a university in Phnom Penh; strong academic record; financial need; commitment to leadership and community
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia-only program; residents are recruited through Harpswell's own selection process in Cambodia (contact Harpswell Phnom Penh)
entries.deadline_note: Recruitment takes place before the Cambodian academic year starts (around mid-year); check the foundation for the current window
entries.language_req: none

entries.name: SHE-CAN Scholar Program (Cambodia)
entries.provider: SHE-CAN (US non-profit)
entries.fields: any (undergraduate degree at a US college or university)
covers: mentoring and leadership training in the US
support to win a full-ride scholarship (tuition, housing) at a top US college
entries.eligibility: Cambodian women aged 17-20 graduating secondary school by June 2027, from low-income/low-opportunity backgrounds, living within about 1 hour of Phnom Penh, strong English, academic excellence and demonstrated leadership, less than 1 year of post-secondary credits, able to dedicate Dec 2026-Jun 2027 to the online pre-college program
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is one of three SHE-CAN countries; apply through the Cambodia Scholar Application 2026-27 form (Trakstar) with Grade 10-12 transcripts and national exam score report in PDF; accepted scholars apply to US colleges for the 2028-29 academic year
entries.deadline_note: Applications usually open in July and close 1 October each year; 2026-27 cycle closes 1 October 2026
entries.language_req: strong spoken and written English (must later pass TOEFL/Duolingo for US colleges)

entries.name: Teach For Cambodia Fellowship
entries.provider: Teach For Cambodia (NGO, Teach For All network)
entries.fields: any degree background; two-year teaching and leadership fellowship in Cambodian public schools
covers: educational award package and alumni network
entries.eligibility: Cambodian nationals with at least a bachelor's degree in any major (recent graduates, young professionals or existing public/private teachers); no teaching experience required; must commit full-time for two years, cohorts start in October
entries.cambodia_note: Program is only for Cambodians; apply online via the TFC application form (tfaforms), then interview and assessment; questions to recruitment@teachforcambodia.org
entries.deadline_note: Applications for each cohort open in stages through the year with several deadlines; cohort begins in October
entries.language_req: Khmer; English useful
